widgets_values: Lively street poster, square format, hot dry sunlight on a cracked city street. A crew of plush stuffed animals hangs out on a corner, each in their own moment: a panda with a skateboard, a fox carrying a boombox on one shoulder, a duckling dragged by a bunch of balloons, a fluffy sheep in the middle of a dance move, a rabbit watching and clapping. Soft long-pile plush fur, barefoot with plush paws, natural relaxed poses, some moving some still, dust and confetti in the air, hard black shadows, deep blue sky, low sun flare. The wordmark is big green bubble graffiti 'KLING' across the top with a black outline and white sticker border; directly under it '4.0' in the same face; below that a small red dry-brush 'IMAGE' tag on a white sticker; one tiny '2026' stamp in a corner. Printed poster feel: halftone dots, paper grain, torn tape at two corners.
